transitionStructuredPlan.summary: Transitioning from Cashier to Dental Hygienist in Ontario, Canada requires completing a 2-3 year college diploma from an approved dental institution, obtaining regional licensing and certification, and gaining supervised clinical experience. The path is challenging with multiple formal requirements and a timeline of approximately 7 to 20 months. Entry-level roles demand maintaining accurate patient records, collaborating with teams, and demonstrating a calm, supportive demeanor. Employers require active certification and registration with the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario (CDHO).
